theorem: The selected 270-line layer provides a 270-address, diameter-3, 15-vertex/15-edge-connected unweighted routing graph; the 135-point layer gives diameter 3 and connectivity 12. Both beat the Levi flag line graph on hop diameter/connectivity, while W33 remains the strongest compact 40-address mixer.
boundary: Unweighted finite routing comparison only; optical loss, latency, detector error, coupler cost and fault-tolerance thresholds remain external weights.
